paragraphs: CourtSmart designs and installs digital audio and video recording systems for courtrooms. The same recording technology is offered for hearing rooms, interview rooms and conferences.

Audio moves from the courtroom to recording servers or workstations over Dante digital transport. A room can record on its own PC or laptop or onto networked central servers, with automatic archiving either way. Staff can annotate proceedings, and the recording system can be tied into a case management system. A docket display application pulls calendar and public access information from the court's case management system.

The company says its recording systems capture millions of hours of legal proceedings in the United States and internationally. Integration is built on ODBC open standards. For remote hearings, a portable system can be taken along and the recordings uploaded afterwards to a central site for permanent storage.

quote.text: Take control of your courtroom with CourtSmart installed technology.
